acceptance_question: Does Current Xi turn the accepted high-density fixed identities, hierarchies and boundaries into a coherent hierarchy-first learner path with minimal first-round memorization debt, while keeping Chengfeng continuous study primary and Xiao1000 downstream?

master_chain: direction and New Era historical position
reform and opening as fundamental driving force
economic institutions / development logic and education-science-talent support
democracy / rule of law / culture / livelihood-social governance / ecology
national security / strong military / reunification / diplomacy
strict Party governance and self-revolution as long-term governing capacity
whole_subject.strongest_attack: Xi has the highest hat-list and fixed-formulation density in Politics, so the main risk is that content closure could silently become a memorization wall. Fresh C00-C17 readback found the opposite: every chapter first assigns role/layer, derives why the object appears now, names the decisive boundary, and keeps dense content_support explicitly backend-only. The hardest cases—C07 repeating New Development Philosophy, C15's ten-item Taiwan role chain, and C17's dense Party-building identities—are already constrained as bridge/role/boundary structures rather than compulsory first-round recitation. Projection must still prove that this backend restraint survives the learner-facing page.
negative_space: Chengfeng remains the only continuous first-study mainline on iPad/MarginNote.
content_support completeness does not create render entitlement or mandatory first-round recall.
P2 and low-discrimination detail remain source-primary/deferred unless later evidence activates them.
Fixed formulations are organized by role before precision; the learner is not required to memorize all hats in round one.
No chapter requires a mandatory recall ritual merely because chapter_compression contains a review prompt.
Xiao1000 remains verification/transfer evidence and does not organize Xi first-learning order.

criteria.hierarchy_first: Each chapter establishes role/layer before asking for fixed formulation precision.
criteria.canonical_unit_integrity: All 60 canonical Xi Natural Units remain Chengfeng-owned; Learning does not regroup them by question taxonomy.
criteria.why_now_continuity: Units explain why the next object is needed, creating causal/role continuity rather than adjacent lists.
criteria.cross_chapter_bridge: C00-C17 form one whole-subject architecture from theory identity to self-revolution, with explicit next-chapter handoffs.
criteria.confusable_boundary_control: High-risk identities are separated by object and role: feature/advantage/guarantee; stage/idea/pattern; fundamental/basic political systems; road/system/China under rule of law; principle/path/goal/relationship; leadership versus self-revolution.
criteria.compression: Chapter compression reconstructs the role chain instead of merely shortening the source.
criteria.minimality: Dense lists stay backend/source-primary unless they materially improve discrimination; first round does not become a second memorization course.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: new-era practical problems -> Two Integrations -> scientific system identities -> Six Must Upholds as method -> historical position
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could become an abstract opening page full of high-level hats.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because path/theory-system/method/historical-position are explicitly separated and full lists remain source-primary.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: why socialism with Chinese characteristics -> New Era historical position -> primary-stage boundary -> continuous development
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: New Era and primary-stage judgments are easy to treat as contradictory slogans.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the chapter makes their different semantic levels the central discrimination task.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: national rejuvenation/China Dream -> strategic stages -> Chinese modernization as road -> characteristics -> essential requirements -> civilizational meaning -> principles -> major relationships
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Highest layer-confusion risk: characteristics, essential requirements, major principles and major relationships can become four parallel lists.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because each group is explicitly assigned a different question: what it is, what it must be, how to advance it, and how to balance tensions.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: Party leadership's highest-level position -> comprehensive leadership -> institutionalized leadership
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Four Party-leadership hats could collapse into pure wording recall.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because feature/advantage/highest political force/fundamental guarantee are bound to distinct role questions before precision.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: people's fundamental position -> people-first value stance -> mass line / people-centered development -> common prosperity
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: People-first, mass line and common prosperity can look like synonyms.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because value stance, work method and long-term development requirement are kept on separate layers.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: why reform remains necessary -> reform strategic identity -> total goal/system method -> reform has no endpoint
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could reduce reform to historical slogans or current policy inventory.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because strategic role, total goal, governance-system boundary and persistence are learned before policy detail.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: basic economic institutions -> New Development Stage/Philosophy/Pattern -> high-quality development -> new quality productive forces / rural modernization
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Very high density: system, stage, philosophy, pattern, theme and productive-force form can all be mistaken for hats.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because each concept answers a distinct foundation/position/method/layout/practice question and detailed policy remains source-primary.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: innovation-development context -> education cultivation base -> science-tech innovation capability -> talent as subject -> integrated support chain
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: The opening New Development Philosophy unit risks duplicating C06 and adding learner operations.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because it functions as a short bridge that explains why education-science-talent belongs under high-quality development, not as a second full lesson on the philosophy.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: political-system confidence -> whole-process people's democracy -> institutional realization -> united front broadens political cohesion
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: People's congress, political consultation, regional autonomy and united front can become a flat political-system list.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the logic distinguishes democratic property, institutional layers, institution-versus-CPPCC organization, and political-cohesion function.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: rule-of-law road -> rule-of-law system -> rule-of-law China overall practice
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Road, system and rule-of-law China are lexically similar and easily merged.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because direction/principle, institutional system and overall governance practice are explicitly separated; joint advancement and integrated construction are also distinguished.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: culture as deep national force -> Party cultural leadership -> core values -> civilizational roots and creative transformation
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Cultural leadership, core values and civilization characteristics can become unrelated memorization blocks.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because they are learned as direction, common-value center and civilizational root respectively.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: people's happiness as value endpoint -> employment/income/social security institutions -> social-governance mechanisms
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Dense livelihood hats could become a welfare-term queue.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the chapter first fixes purpose, then institutional supports, then governance; employment/income/social-security identities are discrimination objects rather than learning order.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: human-nature life community -> Two Mountains relation -> Beautiful China domestic transformation -> global ecological cooperation
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could shrink ecology into pollution-control measures.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the chapter owns development-view change first, then domestic practice and global governance; concrete tools remain source-primary.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: overall national-security concept -> people/politics/economy/security-role map -> coordinate development and security -> multi-domain capability
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: The core elements can become a five-item role chant detached from system thinking.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because 'overall' and cross-domain transmission are the organizing logic, with role words used as precision after the system model.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: why strong military matters -> strong-military goal -> absolute Party leadership -> modernization capability path
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Soul/core/guarantee and military-leadership hats are easy to over-memorize.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because strategic necessity, target dimensions, political guarantee and capability path stay separate.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: one country as premise / two systems as arrangement -> Hong Kong/Macao governance -> Taiwan reunification strategy
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: The ten-item Taiwan overall-strategy role chain is the strongest memorization-wall risk in Xi.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because Current frames the ten items by semantic role and keeps detailed expansion in Chengfeng; first learning is principle-framework -> governance -> reunification path, not ten-item recitation.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: world transformation -> major-country diplomacy principles -> peaceful development with core-interest boundary -> community with a shared future / global governance
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Diplomacy mainline, starting/ending point, purpose and overall goal can turn into role-word trivia.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the chapter derives them from external-environment needs and separates national-interest action from global-governance vision.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: why long-term governing creates self-risk -> comprehensive strict governance -> political construction leading Party building -> anti-corruption -> self-revolution as renewal mechanism
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Highest late-book hat density; Party leadership from C03 could also be duplicated here.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because C03 answers who leads while C17 answers how the leading force remains capable; strict governance, anti-corruption and self-revolution are arranged as increasingly deep self-renewal layers.

conclusion.note: This fresh review accepts Xi Learning Logic only. Projection must now prove that backend content density stays progressively disclosed and that Chengfeng remains external-primary. Runtime, Evidence and User Validation are not inferred.
